acceptanceCriteria: Duplicated identities with missing or invalid spec locations are ambiguous or explicitly refused, never pooled as proven repeat observations.
Add missing-line/column repeat regressions for stability and compare; preserve normal repeat-each, composed shards, and byte-identical single-repeat output.
body: Confirmed on reviewed HEAD 45d1cb07dbf13075920f4faf1d174b01890c572f for GH #809. Runtime: Go 1.27.2 darwin/arm64. Remove line and column from every spec in repeat3.json and Parse succeeds. Stability at minRuns 3 still emits three DETERMINISTIC entries and an INTERMITTENT cart entry instead of IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS. jsonSpec uses plain int fields so missing locations become (0,0), and resolveRepeats regards equal missing locations as proof of one spec location. Expected: only duplicated occurrences with affirmative source-location evidence may be explained by repeatEach; absent location must retain ambiguity or a named refusal. Source internal/playwrightruns/reader.go:157-168,197-201. Existing TestRepeatCountMismatchAmbiguous covers differing locations but not absent locations. Reproduction: temporary overlay TestReviewProbe/absent_spec_locations.

completion.reason: Codex round-1 finding fixed: repeated identities without a reported spec location are ambiguous and not counted as repeats; regression test added (PWR-V0-011..023, accepted). Codex round 2 PASS. Delivered in beamfall/corvint#816, merged to main at 469f260b8. Tests on go1.27.2: the batch's focused packages PASS, go vet clean, doc gates PASS, CEM check and seal PASS. full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the lane build-log record at the merge commit.
